primaryStandards.description: I can identify transformation sequences that map figures onto themselves or other figures.
I can identify reflection, rotation, and translation symmetry in geometric figures.
I can use transformations to justify that two figures are similar.
I can justify triangle similarity criteria using dilations and other similarity transformations.
I can solve problems involving congruent and similar two-dimensional figures.
I can define sine, cosine, and tangent ratios for acute angles in right triangles.
I can solve right-triangle problems using trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean Theorem.
